_readme: OpenSky secrets. Copy to secrets.json (keep it private: chmod 600). Only the Pi's server reads this file; it is never sent to the screen or the network. Leave anything you don't use empty.

calendar._caldav: One entry per calendar in opensky.json with "type": "caldav" (same name). iCloud: use an app-specific password (appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security). Fastmail/Nextcloud: put your server's CalDAV address in url.
